verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any setting, policy, or control that lets users opt out of having their code or prompts used for model training. Related items, such as the default local SQLite storage and provider account login, are adjacent features that do not address training data use. Because data-use controls are a fair question for an AI coding agent, the axis applies, and the lack of evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can opt out of having my code and prompts used for AI model training
